author: mindmap-write
readerQuestion: How do I convert my annual salary to an hourly wage, and my hourly wage to an annual salary? [PAA unread - DataForSEO unavailable; ac 3/14 how-pattern: how to salary calculator hourly, how pay calculator, how wage calculator]

presentation.placement: Page top, directly under the opening answer
presentation.reason: The reader enters one pay figure and hours; the tool returns every pay period at once.
readerInputs: Pay period it is quoted in

interaction.reason: Adjustable inputs change the answer; a static table cannot cover each reader's pay, hours or filing status.

animation.reason: Static result cards answer faster; no sequence or change over time needs motion.

decisionGap: Readers compare pay offers quoted per hour, per month or per year, and few see how the weekly hours behind a salary change the effective hourly rate.
finding: Hourly pay equals annual pay divided by hours per week times weeks per year, so $52,000 at 40 hours and 52 weeks is $25.00 an hour. The same $60,000 salary is $32.97 an hour at 35 hours a week, $30.77 at 37.5, $28.85 at 40 and $25.64 at 45.
conditions: Gross pay before tax. 52 paid weeks and a 5-day week by default; weekly, biweekly, daily and hourly amounts are pay for time worked, monthly and semimonthly amounts divide annual pay by 12 and 24. Overtime premiums, bonuses and unpaid weeks are not modeled.
whatWouldChange: Different hours per week, fewer paid weeks, overtime pay or a different pay-period convention change the hourly figure; take-home pay needs tax and is answered by the paycheck calculator.
caseDecisions: Retrieved cases.json holds only unrelated Layer3Labs owned-property records (e.g. Drones & Defense); none overlaps a pay-conversion or take-home calculator, so no client or fleet record is used and none is claimed. No client-conversation attribution on this page.
method: annual = hourly x hours per week x weeks per year; every other period derived from annual pay (weekly = annual/weeks, biweekly = annual/(weeks/2), monthly = annual/12, semimonthly = annual/24, daily = annual/(days x weeks)). The 35 to 45 hour table is plain arithmetic shown as an illustration.
units: USD per period (hour, day, week, two weeks, half month, month, year); hours per week; weeks per year
limitations: Pure arithmetic on reader inputs. No tax, overtime, bonus, benefits or unpaid-leave modeling. The hours table is an illustration, not research.
counterexample: The same $60,000 salary is $28.85 an hour at 40 hours but $25.64 at 45 hours, and 50 paid weeks instead of 52 raises the 40-hour rate from $28.85 to $30.00.

provenance.scopeAndLimits: Arithmetic conversion on reader inputs only; the 35-45 hour table is an illustration, not a finding from testing or research; no external figures.
provenance.publicMethod: On-page 'How the Salary Conversion Works' section states the formula and assumptions; the table section names the fixed inputs.
provenance.placement: howItWorks paragraph one and the 'Salary Versus Hourly Pay by Hours and Weeks Worked' section

takeaway: Salary / (hours x weeks) = hourly. Applies to any pay offer; the answer changes if hours, unpaid weeks or overtime differ. Gross is not take-home; the paycheck calculator covers take-home.
selectedMedium: interactive tool with the key answer, assumptions and finite tables readable in the static page
testingDecision: Ordinary format: calculated page; finance topic and calculator are outside _experience.md section G. No tested label, howWeTested or tested schema.
